encoder_retention_failure.action: Retire tape-wrap trial after reported wobble; evaluate owner-proposed close-fitting metal rod before changing encoder location
encoder_retention_failure.followup_owner_report: Without the holder it spins freely; owner proposes reduced shaft diameter with electrical-tape wrap for grip
encoder_retention_failure.followup_scope: Free rotation without holder confirmed; tape version enters bore but wobbles and needs more reach; exact contact point of prior drag still unknown
encoder_retention_failure.latest_owner_hypothesis: Old holder may have rubbed edge of stationary motor mount; not confirmed

encoder_retention_redesign.status: held while owner-proposed metal rod is evaluated; no wheel-face redesign released
encoder_retention_redesign.preferred_concept: Magnet plate bolted to existing wheel-to-rotor M2 holes; AS5600 on stationary outboard bracket
encoder_retention_redesign.known_wheel_attachment: Owner-confirmed direct M2 bolts attach wheel to rotating motor face
reuse: included magnets subject to field validation
deck and motor brackets if new support clears
encoder_retention_redesign.scope: Candidate only. Bolt access, hub seating, screw engagement, sensor support/headers and 15.5 mm per-side width allowance must be resolved before CAD release; no through-motor tie bolt or bearing preload assumed.

encoder_tape_wrap_trial.status: Failed centering trial: enters bore but wobbles; owner reports shaft needs more reach
encoder_tape_wrap_trial.owner_request: Reduce holder shaft and use a few winds of electrical tape for compliant grip
encoder_tape_wrap_trial.entry_depth_scope: Initial maximum hand-fit depth, not measured available bore depth or a mechanical stop. Stop earlier at any resistance/contact.
encoder_tape_wrap_trial.length_rationale: Use original 14.8 mm reach for shallow seating; remove the 2.5 mm compensation for deeper insertion that caused drag. Sensor gap must be reset and measured.
encoder_tape_wrap_trial.scope: Tape only on insertion end entirely inside rotating bore; exposed neck through stationary bracket stays bare. Check gentle fit, clearance, runout and migration by hand before any sensor test. Not a qualified final rotor coupling.
encoder_tape_wrap_trial.result_owner_report: it does fit but the shaft would have to be longer and it wobbles, hard to get it to stay centered to prevent wobbling

encoder_metal_rod_proposal.status: concept under review; dimensions and retention not selected
encoder_metal_rod_proposal.owner_proposal: 3.4 mm steel rod cut to length with magnet on end
encoder_metal_rod_proposal.bore_measurement_method: Owner-reported 3.4 mm, corroborated by SpeedyFPV 2204 260KV listing; nominal bore dimension accepted. Instrument not specified; no known-size rod fit claimed.
encoder_metal_rod_proposal.material_preference: Nonmagnetic rod with controlled diameter/straightness; magnetic steel is an alternative with a short nonmagnetic magnet holder/spacer and sensor validation
encoder_metal_rod_proposal.shaft_retention: Undecided; close sliding fit must first locate shaft without wobble or force. Rod and magnet both need resistance to axial movement and relative rotation.
encoder_metal_rod_proposal.magnet_mount: Centered short cap/socket with retained 4 x 2 mm diametric magnet; geometry not released
reuse: AS5600 boards and existing supports if clearance permits
4 x 2 mm magnets subject to validation
encoder_metal_rod_proposal.latest_bore_observation: Owner reports hole appears to go through motor; uniform diameter and close support length unverified

bracket_clearance_review.action: Unpowered gentle rod fit and bracket-contact check; relieve plastic opening only if contact confirmed, with motor removed; no relief diameter selected

encoder_metal_rod_proposal.rod_selection_scope: 3.4 mm nominal candidate for close-fit check; supplier rod tolerance and actual fit unverified; no force/press-fit specified

assembly_scope: Historical inboard encoder arrangement; bore-plug retention failed physically; nominal geometry checks do not establish fit
